Class Cauldrons

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.interaction.Cauldrons
public final class Cauldrons extends Object
Vanilla water, lava, and powder-snow cauldron transitions for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets: block-state changes, protection, sound, and cauldron-stat accounting. Bucket state is edited through BucketState directly, since a vanilla cauldron is not modded fluid storage. A finite Big or Huge Bucket is credited or debited one unit; a Source Bucket is left unchanged (an empty one is assigned by FluidTransactions).

Every loader routes vanilla cauldrons here rather than through native block fluid storage: the cauldron dispatchers are wired by register(Item, Item), and the shared fluid logic and dispensers call take(Level, BlockPos, Direction, ItemStack, Cauldrons.CauldronFluid, ProtectionContext) and place(Level, BlockPos, Direction, ItemStack, Cauldrons.CauldronFluid, ProtectionContext).

Each method simulates before checking protection and mutating, and returns whether the transition happened. Mutation and side effects are skipped on the client. The item-use statistic is awarded only by the dispatcher handlers, as vanilla's bucket cauldron interactions do; a Source Bucket reaches a cauldron through its item useOn, whose success vanilla counts.

    • place

      public static boolean place(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, Cauldrons.CauldronFluid fluid, ProtectionContext context)
      Fills an empty cauldron at pos to a full fluid cauldron from the bucket. Checks Protections.mayModify(Level, ProtectionContext, BlockPos, Direction, ItemStack), plays the empty sound, and on server success debits a finite bucket while leaving a Source Bucket unchanged. A Source Bucket at an already full cauldron of fluid reports success without changing either side.
      Returns:
      true when the transition happened

    • takePowder

      public static boolean takePowder(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, int capacityUnits, ProtectionContext context)
      Moves one powder-snow block from a full powder-snow cauldron at pos into stack, leaving an empty cauldron.

      On the server it debits the cauldron, credits the bucket, awards the cauldron-use stat for a player, and emits GameEvent.FLUID_PICKUP; the fill sound plays on both sides.

      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      pos - cauldron position
      face - face to authorize against
      stack - bucket stack, credited one unit on success
      capacityUnits - the bucket tier's powder-snow capacity
      context - authorization identity
      Returns:
      true when the transfer ran; false without mutation unless the cauldron is full, the bucket is empty or already in powder-snow mode below capacityUnits, and protection allows the interaction

    • placePowder

      public static boolean placePowder(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context)
      Moves one powder-snow block from stack into an empty cauldron at pos, filling it to a full powder-snow cauldron.

      On the server it debits the bucket, sets the cauldron, awards the cauldron-fill stat, and emits GameEvent.FLUID_PLACE; the empty sound plays on both sides.

      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      pos - cauldron position
      face - face to authorize against
      stack - bucket stack, debited one unit on success
      context - authorization identity
      Returns:
      true when the transfer ran; false without mutation unless the target is an empty cauldron, the bucket is in powder-snow mode, and protection allows the interaction
